reason: Adds a DeepSeek Harness describe_image tool that accepts image inputs and uses a configured OpenAI-compatible vision-language endpoint to return textual descriptions.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉语言模型，将本地文件、网络图片或附件引用转换为图片文字描述。
summaries.en: Uses an OpenAI-compatible vision-language model to turn local files, remote images, or attachment references into textual image descriptions.

capabilities: Accepts a local image path, HTTP(S) image URL, or harness attachment reference
Sends image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision-language model endpoint
Returns generated image description text to the conversation
Uses configured API credentials for the vision-language endpoint
